question: Why does Bhairava praise the question asked by the great goddess?
premises: He states he has been asked
The matter asked is hard for gods to obtain
inference: Bhairava praises the goddess because her question concerns knowledge rare even for the gods
uncertainties: sura durlabham may be taken as a compound or closely linked words
plain_english: Well said, well said, O Great Goddess; I have been asked about something hard for even the gods to obtain.
